are_you_ok.title: Denver health specialists warn of extreme heat risks for people and pets
are_you_ok.summary: Extreme heat health warning affecting the whole metro population this weekend.
are_you_ok.description: With continued high temperatures across Colorado, it's important to recognize the symptoms of heat related illness. Health experts are sharing tips to protect yourself and your pets this weekend.

conversation_starters.title: Denver's Underground Music Showcase returns in new home, giving local artists a fresh stage
conversation_starters.summary: Colorado's longest-running independent music festival returns in a new RiNo home, running now; marquee metro civic event and a work-safe opener. You could open with: 'Did you catch the Underground Music Showcase in its new RiNo spot this weekend?'
conversation_starters.description: The Underground Music Showcase is turning the page to a new chapter this weekend, bringing Colorado's longest-running independent music festival to Denver's RiNo Art District. The festival runs through Sunday.

conversation_starters.title: Heavy rains cause flash flooding, mudslides in Colorado high country
conversation_starters.summary: Flash flooding / mudslides in Colorado high country; just-happened weather event with road impact. Distant point event but a natural did-you-hear opener. You could open with: 'Did you hear about the flash flooding and mudslides up in the high country?'
conversation_starters.description: Some drivers traveling through Colorado's high country should be prepared for delays due to a mudslide in Red Mountain Pass.

you_should_know.title: 4th firefighter dies from burn injuries battling Colorado's Knowles wildfire
you_should_know.summary: Fourth firefighter death from CO wildfire, significant local impact context.
you_should_know.description: Nathan Matthews, 43, of Lincoln, Nebraska, died from injuries sustained while battling the blaze, the Department of the Interior said.

you_should_know.title: Denver put weight restriction on 6th bridge; no one is really enforcing weight limit
you_should_know.summary: Sixth Denver bridge with weight restriction and lax enforcement points to aging infrastructure affecting local commutes; context worth walking in aware of. Keep as you should know.
you_should_know.description: Lawrence Street over Cherry Creek joins five other bridges with weight restrictions since late last year.

you_should_know.title: Colorado report finds rural residents face wider health gaps and shorter lives
you_should_know.summary: State report on rural/Native health disparities and shorter lifespans — a structural condition landing statewide, worth walking in aware of but not a check-in. Keep as you should know.
you_should_know.description: American Indian and Alaska Native populations in rural communities see premature death rates nearly double the statewide average, according to the report.
